proposal.thesis: The binding time_box on Baker Hughes has fired and today's tape confirmed it. Entry was 2026-07-28 at $58.20 against a plan that required a sustained daily close above $65 within 30 trading days of the 2026-07-27 earnings breakout; the 2026-09-04 weekly review made 2026-09-09 the last extension of that clock. The 2026-09-09 session tagged $66.09 and closed $63.64 (prices_meta price_as_of 2026-09-09) — a tag that did not hold. A SELL_TO_CLOSE was already submitted after that close (resting_market_closed). On 2026-09-10 the name is live near $59.50-$59.70, down about 6% from yesterday's close, through the chandelier trail at $60.72 (position_histories 2026-09-10 bar low $59.34; StockAnalysis $59.54 at 10:57 a.m. ET). Invalidating_print (IET orders / guidance cut) did not fire — management raised FY2026 sales to $28.5-30.3B at the 2026-09-09 Barclays conference — and invalidating_structure (close below $56) has not printed. I am honoring the written clock and the trail breach, not scratching a leftover +9% mark-to-market. Challenger DELL was considered and is not a swap: 24-analyst mean $564.46 is only +5.5% vs the $535.25 2026-09-09 close.
